description: Recognition thresholds and behavioural timings. These gate behaviour; any animation they trigger uses the motion tokens.
notes: Touch slop and keyboard repeat stay framework-owned and are deliberately NOT tokens.
The gesture thresholds below are the specification's own numbers (07 section 4), not platform conventions.
monokit NEVER claims edge swipes — they belong to system and OS navigation.

longPress.description: Adopts Flutter's kLongPressTimeout; identical on every platform.

hoverIntent.description: The pointer must dwell this long before tooltips and hover cards open.

hoverGrace.description: The pointer may leave the trigger for this long before a hover surface closes.

hapticMinGap.description: Rate limiter. Composed patterns count as one event.

offset.description: Painted OUTSIDE the control's bounds so it never shifts layout, and bound to focus-visible only.

dismissFraction.description: Drag-dismiss commits when travel exceeds 30% of the surface's height along the dismiss axis.

dismissVelocity.description: Or when release velocity exceeds this. Whichever comes first; otherwise the surface returns on the spatial spring.

rubberBand.description: Displacement damping past an end stop. Not specified upstream — a realization choice, recorded in AMENDMENTS.md.

statePrecedence.description: The interaction axis, first match wins. The mode axis (checked, selected, expanded, open, active, invalid) composes orthogonally.
